name: Example: Hole-in-One Jackpot
author: Golf Tycoon examples
description: A gameplay script mod. The course pays a jackpot bounty from the 'insurance fund' every time a visiting golfer aces a hole - and the story draws a crowd for the following week. Everything it uses is the public Mod API: EventBus signals, a value hook, per-mod config and its own slice of the save file. The payout and the crowd boost are configurable.

payout.description: Dollars the fund adds to the course's takings per hole-in-one (sponsor money, not the golfer's).

buzz_days.description: How many days the hole-in-one story keeps drawing extra golfers.

buzz_multiplier.description: Golfer-arrival multiplier while the story is fresh.

announce.description: Toast a notification when a jackpot lands.
